SystemTable.name: external_catalog_info
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `external_catalog_info` ( `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `connector` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `properties` blob DEFAULT NULL, `secret_name` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL, `comment` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_name` (`name`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

SystemTable.name: external_secret
SystemTable.Create: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `external_secret` ( `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL, `type` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL, `encrypted_kv` blob NOT NULL, `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_name` (`name`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
